title: Fourier entropy versus total influence
statement: There exists one finite absolute C such that, for every integer n>=0 and Boolean f:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, sum_{S subset [n]} fhat(S)^2 log2(1/fhat(S)^2) <= C sum_{S subset [n]} |S| fhat(S)^2, using uniform measure and 0 log(1/0)=0.

primary_sources.title: The Fourier Entropy-Influence Conjecture for certain classes of Boolean functions
primary_sources.authors: Ryan O'Donnell, John Wright, Yuan Zhou
primary_sources.locator: PDF page 2, Section 1; displayed FEI formula
primary_sources.supports: Exact normalized uniform-measure statement with base-2 logarithm; not a current-status certificate.

primary_sources.title: Further evidence towards the Fourier Entropy-Influence conjecture
primary_sources.authors: Maria Jose Gonzalez, Paul MacManus, Maria Cristina Pereyra
primary_sources.locator: Introduction, FEI Conjecture and Ansatz 1.1; Section 4
primary_sources.supports: Recent partial results and an inductive route requiring a chosen suitable coordinate. The paper's weaker existence statement is not refuted by the w508 arbitrary-coordinate obstruction.

primary_sources.title: On the Fourier Entropy-Influence Conjecture for Boolean Plateaued Functions
primary_sources.supports: Scope is plateaued and partially bent functions; abstract alone is not used as a proof or a universal FEI solution.
